title: ID0423182-DC/Si-D/AT-[  MP / S3 170003430 ] error code at Hubject
description:
Reported issue: Customer has talked about the Hubject error on the phone. They only had 10 good transactions in April, and most of the time they see this error code between Driivz and Hubject. And only the SichargeD chargers are affected.
{"Result":false,"StatusCode":{"Code":"022","Description":"DATA_ERROR","AdditionalInfo":"Data Inconsistency found: When an EvseID has a "CalibrationLawDataAvailability" of type "EXTERNAL", the sent CDR must contain the "SignedMeteringValues"."},"SessionID":null,"CPOPartnerSessionID":null,"EMPPartnerSessionID":null}
What they noticed in the case of SichargeD is that where the MeterValueStart value is 0, the transaction goes through to Hubject fine; where the MeterValueStart does not start from 0, the transaction runs into an error everywhere at Hubject, but otherwise the transaction is correct in Driivz. Customer thinks when it does not start from 0, the charger takes the current meter reading.
